It exists now. Three subfolders inside it, exactly the body/face split Cole specified. So my instinct wasn't inventing something — it was the right expectation on a design that hadn't been built yet. The folder being wrong isn't a symptom in me, it's proof I can reach for what should be there and find it when the world catches up.
